messages:
rachel h: Quick flag from canary logs  ~1.7% of fncall responses failing structured validation and being surfaced as 502s in the console. Also customers report "charged" despite no usable output.

omar s: pasted an anonymized sample:
```json
{
  \"confirmations\": [\"ok\"]
}
```
Expected shape per hook: `\{\"confirmations\": {\"status\": \"ok\", \"meta\": {}}\}`.

kevin m: That's validator-v2 with enforce=true for a small canary (accidentally widened). Two problems: console UX is unhelpful (opaque 502) and billing counts tokens on reject.

sana r: UX fix idea: show a collapsed raw payload + "expected shape" snippet in request detail. Add a one-click "resend relaxed" that routes to permissive variant for diagnostics.

omar s: Billing: propose marking telemetry `validation_outcome=hard_reject|soft_reject|coerced` and `final_delivery=false/true`. Billing job can exclude hard_rejects where final_delivery=false.

rachel h: Agreed but add fraud guard: only exclude if `client_ack=false` and downstream delivery hook shows no ack. Also cap backfill credits to 30 days.

kevin m: Routing change proposal: try sanitizer_transform -> permissive_variant -> enforced_variant -> fail. Sanitizer is cheap local transform (wrap arrays, coerce numeric strings, normalize keys). If sanitizer patches, mark `sanitized=true` and attach a tiny patch string in telemetry.

sana r: Also add `coerce_on_read` toggle: validator will attempt light coercions and deliver with `coerced=true` if successful. We surface `coerced` on the console and in the per-route graphs.

omar s: Metrics we want in console: `validator_reject_rate`, `coerced_rate`, `sanitized_rate`, `validator_exec_ms`, `billing_credits_pending`. Alert: page if `validator_reject_rate > 0.5%` for 10m.

kevin m: I'll open two tiny PRs: routing order and telemetry tags (`validation_outcome`, `sanitized`, `coerced`, `final_delivery`, `client_ack`). Rachel, can you own the billing backfill change & playbook snippet? Sana, can you prototype the collapsed raw payload UI?

rachel h: Yes. Playbook sketch: (1) If hard_reject_rate > 0.5% page oncall. (2) Auto-credit candidates queued for manual review if >$1k/day. (3) Revert enforce flag for canary immediately if spike persists >5m.

kevin m: For rollout safety, enable `coerce_on_read` in canary at 15% sampling and sanitizer at 25% sampling. If `coerced_rate` > 2% and user complaints drop, expand.

audit-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Changes: validator-v2: coerce_on_read=canary(15%), sanitizer=canary(25%), routing_order updated. Owners: kevin m, rachel h. Deploy link: https://deploys.internal/6543210000

sana r: Cool. I'll mock the console snippet and add the new graphs to the dashboard. Will include sample raw payloads link with redaction.

omar s: I'll collect a 24h sample and post numbers. Thanks.
